description: Layer 3 - Infrastructure: Add health probes to container-app.bicep, resolve duplicate deploy paths by removing per-app deploys from CI and consolidating on deploy-all.yml
steps: In infra/azure/container-app.bicep: Add liveness and readiness health probes to the container configuration. Add a 'probes' array to the container object with: (1) A liveness probe: type 'Liveness', httpGet on path '/health' port 8000, periodSeconds 30, failureThreshold 3, initialDelaySeconds 10. (2) A readiness probe: type 'Readiness', httpGet on path '/health' port 8000, periodSeconds 10, failureThreshold 3, initialDelaySeconds 5.
In .github/workflows/ci-edge.yml: Remove the entire 'deploy' job. The edge deploy already happens via deploy-all.yml on push to main. Keep only the lint-and-typecheck and test jobs for PR validation.

In .github/workflows/ci-frontend.yml: Remove the entire 'deploy' job. The frontend deploy already happens via deploy-all.yml on push to main. Keep only the lint-and-typecheck and test jobs for PR validation.

In .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml: Add a 'ci-checks' job at the top that runs lint/typecheck/tests for all apps, then make deploy-backend, deploy-edge, and deploy-frontend depend on ci-checks passing. This ensures the consolidated deploy pipeline gates on quality checks.
acceptance_criteria: container-app.bicep contains liveness and readiness probes on /health port 8000
ci-edge.yml no longer has a deploy job
ci-frontend.yml no longer has a deploy job
deploy-all.yml has a ci-checks job that runs tests before deploys
verification: Run: grep 'deploy' .github/workflows/ci-edge.yml | grep -i 'job\|name' || echo 'OK: no deploy job'
Run: grep 'deploy' .github/workflows/ci-frontend.yml | grep -i 'job\|name' || echo 'OK: no deploy job'
Run: python3 -c "import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/deploy-all.yml')); print('ci-checks' in d.get('jobs',{}))"
findings: All changes verified via YAML parsing and grep. Health probes added to Bicep, deploy jobs removed from per-app CI, quality gates added to deploy-all.yml with proper needs dependencies.
